notes.zh-CN: 302.AI 编程入口移到 Qwen Code 下方、302.AI 媒体上方，便于在编程和媒体能力间切换。包含自动加载、搜索和刷新聊天模型，以及独立媒体模型选择。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅适用于团队已注册设备。
notes.en: 302.AI Coding now appears below Qwen Code and directly above 302.AI Media. Includes automatic loading, search and refresh of chat models plus separate media-model selection. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
